Definition: Kots, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Coz begets Anub and Zobebah in Judah's genealogy, the children of Koz are among the priests who return, and Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz, repairs the wall. Two men share the name, one in the line and one on the wall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the family of Koz is named in the lists and on the wall, and God keeps the builders' names.
